7.2.1.v: Before the Aorist-characteristic स् (सिच्), वृद्धि is substituted in the परस्मैपद for the final of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इ , उ , ऋ (long or short -- इको गुणवृद्धी [[1.1.3]]).
7.2.1.e: An अङ्ग ending in the सिच्-प्रत्यय gets a वृद्धि आदेश in presence of a प्रत्यय belonging to परस्मैपद.
7.2.1.sa: परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्यये परे सिच्-प्रत्ययान्तस्य अङ्गस्य वृद्धि-आदेशः भवति ।
7.2.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.2.v: वृद्धि is substituted for the short अ when it is immediately followed by the final र् or ल् of a root, before the परस्मैपद s-Aorist.

7.2.3.v: In the परस्मैपद s-Aorist there is वृद्धि of the अ of वद , व्रज् and of any vowel, without distinction, of the अङ्ग (stems) ending in a consonant.

7.2.4.v: The vowel of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a consonant does not get वृद्धि when the स् (सिच्) takes the augment इट् ।

7.2.5.v: The वृद्धि of the vowel of the following अङ्ग (stems), does not take place before the इट् augment s-Aorist in the परस्मैपद ; namely - the अङ्ग (stems) ending in 1. ह् 2. म् or 3. य् , the roots 1. क्षण् 2. श्वस् 3. जागृ , a stem formed with णि, the root श्वि and the roots having an indicatory ए in the धातुपाठ।

7.2.6.v: Before an इट् beginning substituted-Aorist of the परस्मैपद there is optional वृद्धि of the vowel of ऊर्णु।

7.2.7.v: Before the इट् beginning s-Aorist of the परस्मैपद the short अ of the root gets optionally वृद्धि when the अङ्ग (stem) begins with a consonant and the अ is prosodially short by being followed by a simple consonant.

7.2.8.v: The augment इट् is not added to a कृत् affix beginning with a sonant consonant (वश् प्रत्यहार).

7.2.9.v: The इट् augment is not taken by the following कृत् affixes - 1. ति 2. तु 3. त्र 4. त 5. थ 6. सि 7. सु 8. सर 9. क and 10. स।

7.2.10.v: The augment इट् is not added to that affix which is joined to a root, which in the Grammatical system of Instruction (i.e. in the धातुपाठ) is one syllable and is without accent (अनुदात्त).
7.2.10.sa: यः धातु औपदेशिक-अवस्थायामनुदात्त-एकाच्-अस्ति, तस्मात् परः इडागमः न भवति ।
7.2.10.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.11.v: The augment इट् is not added to an affix having an indicatory फ् when it comes after the root श्रि or after a mono-syllabic root ending in 1. उ 2. ऊ 3. ऋ or 4. ॠ in the धातुपाठ।

7.2.12.v: The Desiderative affix सन् does not get the augment इट् , not only after roots ending in 1. उ 2. ऊ 3. ऋ and 4. ॠ but also after ग्रह and गुह।

7.2.13.v: The personal endings of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) do not get the augment इट् after 1 कृ 2. सृ 3. भृ 4. वृ 5. स्तु 6. द्रु 7. स्रु 8.श्रु।

7.2.14.v: The participial affixes त and तवत् (क्त and क्तवतु) do not get the इट् augment after श्वि and after the root which has an indicatory ई।

7.2.15.v: The participial affixes do not take the इट् augment after those roots, to which another suffix can optionally be added, with or without this augment इ।

7.2.16.v: The participial affixes do not take the इट् augment after a root which has an indicatory आ।

7.2.17.v: The participial affixes optionally take the इट् augment after roots having an indicatory आ when the affixes have an Impersonal sense or denote the beginning of an action.

7.2.18.v: The following words are made without the इट् augment in the senses given against them - 1. क्षुब्ध 'a churning stick' 2. स्वान्तः 'the mind' 3. ध्वान्तः 'darkness' 4. लग्नः 'attached' 5. म्लिष्टः 'indistinct or unintelligible' 6. विरिब्धः 'a note or a tone' 7. फाण्टः 'made without an effort or by an easy process' and 8. बाढः 'excessive'.

7.2.19.v: The participial affix does not get इट् augment after the roots 1. धृष् and 2. शस् when meaning 'bold, impudent and arrogant'.

7.2.20.v: The irregularly formed Past Participle दृढ means 'stout' and 'strong'.

7.2.22.v: The participial affix does not take the augment इट् after the root कष् when the participle means 'difficult' and 'impenetrable'.

7.2.23.v: The participial affix does not take the augment इट् after the root घुष् in any sense other than that of 'proclaimed'.

7.2.24.v: The participial affix does not take the augment इट् after the root अर्द when it is preceded by 1. सं 2. नि or 3. वि।

7.2.25.v: The participial affix does not take the augment इट् after the root अर्द when it is preceded by अभि, when the meaning is that of 'near'.

7.2.26.v: The word वृत्त is formed from the causative of वृत् in the sense of 'studied through or read'.

7.2.27.v: The following irregularly formed participles from the causative roots may optionally take इट् - 1. दान्त 2. शान्त 3. पूर्ण 4. दस्त 5. स्पष्ट 6. छन्न and 7. ज्ञप्त।

7.2.28.v: The participial affix may optionally get इट् augment after 1. रुष् 2. अम् 3. त्वर 4. संघुष् and 5. आस्वन्।

7.2.29.v: The participial affix may optionally get इट् augment after हृष् when the word लोमन् or its synonym is in construction with it.

7.2.30.v: And after अपचित has also a second form with the augment इ ।

7.2.31.v: ह्रु is substituted for ह्वर् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before the Participial-affix.

7.2.32.v: The word अपरिह्वृता is irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

7.2.33.v: ह्वरित् is irregularly formed from ह्वृ in the छन्दस् (Vedas) by गुण substitution and इट् augment when it refers to सोम।

7.2.34.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the following irregular forms are found, some with and some without the augment इट् 1. ग्रसित 2. स्कभित 3. स्तभित 4. उत्तभित 5. चत्त 6. विकस्त 7. विशस्तॄ 8. शंस्तृ 9. शास्तृ 10. तरुतृ 11. तरूतृ 12. वरुतृ 13. वरूतृ 14. वरुत्रीः 15. उज्ज्वलिति 16. क्षरिति 17. क्षमिति 18. वमिति and 19. अमिति।

7.2.35.v: An आर्धधातुक affix -- आर्द्धधातुकं शेषः [[3.4.114]] etc., beginning with a consonant (except य) gets the augment इट् (in these rules).
7.2.35.e: An आर्धधातुक-प्रत्यय that starts with a वल् letter gets an इट् आगम.
7.2.35.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.36.v: The augment इट् is added to a आर्धधातुक वलादि affixes after स्नु and क्रम् only then they do not occasion the taking of the personal endings of the आत्मनेपद ।

7.2.37.v: The augment इट् added to वलादि आर्धधातुक affixes, becomes lengthened, except in the personal endings of the लिट् (Perfect Tense), after the root ग्रह।

7.2.38.v: The इट् augment is optionally lengthened after वॄ , वृञ् and after roots ending in long ॠ, except in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.2.39.v: The इट् is not lengthened after वॄ , वृञ् and after roots ending in long ॠ in the endings of the Benedictive.

7.2.40.v: The इट् is not lengthened after वॄ , वृञ् and after roots ending in long ॠ in the s-Aorist of the परस्मैपद ।

7.2.41.v: The Desiderative स् may optionally take इट् (which is optionally lengthened also) after the said after वृ and ॠ ending roots.

7.2.42.v: The इट् is optionally added to endings of the आत्मनेपद Benedictive and s-Aorist, after वृ and ॠ ending roots.

7.2.43.v: The इट् is optionally added to endings of the आत्मनेपद Benedictive and s-Aorist, after a root which ends in short ऋ which is preceded by a conjunct consonant.

7.2.44.v: A वलादि आर्धधातुक affix optionally takes इट् after स्वृ , after the two roots सू (सूति and सूयति) after धूञ् and after a root which has an indicatory long ऊ।

7.2.45.v: A वलादि आर्धधातुक affix optionally takes इट् after रध् and the seven roots that follow it (दिवादिगणः (4th Conjugation) 94 to 91).

7.2.46.v: A वलादि आर्धधातुक affix optionally takes इट् after कुष् when it is preceded by निर्।

7.2.47.v: The augment इट् is added to the Participial affixes त and तवत् after कुष् when it is preceded by निर्।

7.2.48.v: An आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a त may optionally take the इट् affix after the roots 1. इष् 2. सह् 3. लुभ् 4. रुष् and 5. रिष्।

7.2.49.v: The Desiderative स् may optionally take the इट् augment after a root ending in इव् and after 1. ऋधु 2. भ्रस्ज 3. दम्भु 4. श्रि 5. स्वृ 6. यु 7. ऊर्णु 8. भृ 9. ज्ञप् and 10. सन्।

7.2.50.v: The affixes क्त्वा , क्त and क्त्वातु optionally get the इट् augment after क्लिश्।

7.2.51.v: The affixes क्त्वा , क्त and क्त्वातु optionally get the इट् augment after पू।

7.2.52.v: The affixes क्त्वा , क्त and क्त्वातु always get the इट् augment after वस् 'to dwell' and क्षुध्।

7.2.53.v: The affixes क्त्वा , क्त and क्त्वातु get the इट् augment after the root अञ्च् when meaning 'to honour or do something to show honour'.

7.2.54.v: The affixes क्त्वा , क्त and क्त्वातु get the इट् augment after the root लुभ् (तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation)) when meaning 'entangled of confused'.

7.2.55.v: The affix क्त्वा gets the इट् augment after जॄ and जॄव्रश्च्।

7.2.56.v: The affix क्त्वा optionally gets the इट् augment after a root which has an indicatory short उ।

7.2.57.v: An आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a स् (except सिच् the characteristic of s-Aorist) may optionally take the इट् augment after the verbs 1. कृत् (तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) and रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) 2. चृत् - तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) 3. छृद् - रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) 4. तृद् -- तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) and 5. नृत् -- दिवादिगणः (4th Conjugation).

7.2.58.v: An आर्धधातुक affix beginning with स् gets the इट् augment after गम् 'to go' in the परस्मैपद ।

7.2.59.v: The परस्मैपद आर्धधातुक affixes beginning with स् do not get the इट् augment after वृत् and the three roots (वृध् , शृध् and स्यन्द्) that follow it.

7.2.60.v: The परस्मैपद आर्धधातुक affixes beginning with स् and the affix तास् (the sign of the Periphrastic Future) do not get the इट् augment after the root कॢप्।

7.2.61.v: After a root which ends in a vowel and after the Periphrastic Future affix तासि is always devoid of the इट् augment (after such a root) थल् the personal ending of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) तास्, does not also get the augment इट् ।

7.2.62.v: After a root which possesses a short अ as its root-vowel in the original enunciation (the धातुपाठ) and after which the Periphrastic Future तास् is always devoid of the augment इट् , थल् the personal-ending of the लिट् (Perfect Tense), like तास् does not get the augment इट् ।

7.2.63.v: In the opinion of भारद्वाज , it is only after a root which ends in short ऋ and after which the Periphrastic Future तास् is always devoid of the augment इट् , थल् the personal-ending of the लिट् (Perfect Tense), like तास् does not get the augment इट् ।

7.2.64.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) are found the irregular forms 1. बभूथ 2. आततन्थ 3. जगृम्भ 4. and 5. ववर्थ।

7.2.65.v: थल् the personal-ending of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) gets the augment इट् after सृज् and दृश्।

7.2.66.v: थल् the personal-ending of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) gets the augment इट् after 1. अद् 2. ॠ and 3. व्यय्।

7.2.67.v: The Participial affix वस् gets the augment इट् only then the reduplicated root before it consists of one syllable or when it comes after a root ending in long आ and after घस्।

7.2.68.v: The affix वस् optionally takes इट् after 1. गम् 'to go' 2. हन् 'to kill' 3. विद् 'to know' and 4. विश् 'to enter'.

7.2.69.v: The form सनिवांसम् with सनि is irregularly formed.

7.2.70.v: स्य the sign of Future and Conditional gets the augment इट् after a root ending in short ऋ and after हन् 'to kill'.

7.2.71.v: The स् of the s-Aorist always takes the इट् augment after अञ्ज् - रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation).

7.2.72.v: The सिच् of the Aorist in परस्मैपद takes the augment इट् after the roots 1. स्तु 2. सु and 3. धूञ्।

7.2.73.v: The सिच् of the Aorist in परस्मैपद takes the augment इट् after the roots 1. यम् 2. रम् 3. नम् and roots ending in the long आ and स् (सक्) is added at the end of these अङ्ग (stems).

7.2.74.v: The Desiderative सन् gets the augment इट् after the roots 1. स्मिङ् 2. पूङ् 3. ऋ 4. अञ्जू and 5. अशू।

7.2.75.v: The Desiderative सन् gets the augment इट् after the root कॄ - तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) and the four roots that follow it.

7.2.76.v: A सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant other than य gets the augment इट् after the root रुद् - रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) and the four that follow it.

7.2.77.v: The सार्वधातुक affix से (the ending of the 2nd person Present and Imperative आत्मनेपदि) get the augment इट् after the root ईश - अदादिगणः (2nd Conjugation).

7.2.78.v: The सार्वधातुक affixes से and ध्वे (the endings of the Present and Imperative आत्मनेपदि) get the augment इट् after the roots ईड् - अदादिगणः (2nd Conjugation) and जन् 'to produce'.

7.2.79.v: In the सार्वधातुक लिङ् (Potential) the स् which is not final (i.e. the स् of the augments यास् and सीय् ) is elided.
7.2.79.e: For सार्वधातुक-लिङ्लकार, the सकार which is present in the प्रत्यय but which is not present at the end of the प्रत्यय is removed.
7.2.79.sa: सार्वधातुक-लिङ्लकारस्य प्रत्यये यः  सकारः अन्ते विद्यमानः नास्ति, तस्य लोपः भवति ।
7.2.79.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.80.v: After a Present अङ्ग (stem) ending in a short अ , इय् is substituted for the सार्वधातुक या (i.e. for the या of the augment यास् of the लिङ् (Potential)).
7.2.80.e: 'या' present in the प्रत्यय of  सार्वधातुक-लिङ्लकार is converted to एय् when it follows an अकार.
7.2.80.sa: अवर्णात् परस्य सार्वधातुक-लिङ्लकारस्य प्रत्ययस्य 'या'  इत्यस्य  इय्-आदेशः भवति ।
7.2.80.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.81.v: For the आ being a portion of a सार्वधातुक personal-ending which is ङित् (i.e. आते , आथे and आताम् and आथाम्), coming after a verbal अङ्ग (stem) ending in a short अ , there is substituted इय् ।

7.2.82.v: Before the participial ending आन , a verbal अङ्ग (stem) ending in shot अ , gets the augment मुक्।

7.2.83.v: ई is substituted for the आ of आन after आस्।

7.2.84.v: आ is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a case-ending.
7.2.84.e: The word अष्टन् gets an optional आकारादेश when followed by a हलादि विभक्तिप्रत्यय.
7.2.84.sa: अष्टन्-शब्दस्य हलादौ विभक्तिप्रत्यये परे विकल्पेन आकारादेशः भवति ।
7.2.84.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.85.v: Before a case-ending beginning with a consonant, आ is substituted for the final of रै।
7.2.85.e: The word 'रै' gets an आकारादेश when followed by  हलादि विभक्तिप्रत्यय.
7.2.85.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.86.v: आ is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before a case-ending.

7.2.87.v: आ is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before the case-ending of the Accusative -2nd case.

7.2.88.v: आ is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before the case-ending of the Nominative 1st-Case dual in the secular literature.

7.2.89.v: य is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before a case-ending which is not a substitute and which begins with a vowel.

7.2.90.v: In the remaining cases where (आ or य is not substituted) there is elision of the final युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

7.2.91.v: The substitutions taught hereafter up to प्रतयोत्तरपदयोश्च [[7.2.98]] take effect with regard to the portions of युष्मद् and अस्मद् up to म् i.e. the substitutes replace युष्म् and अस्म्।

7.2.92.v: In the dual, युव is substituted for युष्म् and आव for अस्म्।

7.2.93.v: In the Nominative 1st-Case plural यूय is substituted for युष्म् and वय for अस्म्।

7.2.94.v: In the Nominative 1st-Case singular त्व is substituted for युष्म् and अह for अस्म्।

7.2.95.v: In the Dative -4th Case singular तुभ्य is substituted for युष्म् and मह्य for अस्म्।

7.2.96.v: In the Genitive 6th-Case singular तव is substituted for युष्म् and मम for अस्म्।

7.2.97.v: In the remaining cases of the singular त्व is substituted for युष्म् and म for अस्म्।

7.2.98.v: त्व is substituted for युष्म् and म for अस्म् when they signify a single individual, even when an affix follows or a word is in composition.

7.2.99.v: तिसृ is substituted for त्रि and चतसृ for चतुर् in the feminine when a case-ending follows.
7.2.99.e: The words  त्रि and चतुर् are respectively converted to तिसृ and चतसृ to indicate the feminine property, when followed by a विभक्ति-प्रत्यय
7.2.99.sa: विभक्तिप्रत्यये परे त्रि-शब्दस्य चतुर्-शब्दस्य च स्त्रीत्वं द्योतयितुम् तिसृ तथा चतसृ - एतौ आदेशौ भवतः ।
7.2.99.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.100.v: र् is substituted for ऋ of तिसृ and चतसृ before the case-affixes beginning with a vowel.
7.2.100.e: The ऋकार of the words तिसृ and चतसृ is converted to रेफ when followed by an  अजादि-विभक्तिप्रत्यय.
7.2.100.sa: तिसृ-शब्दस्य चतसृ-शब्दस्य ऋकारस्य अजादि-विभक्तौ परे रेफादेशः भवति ।
7.2.100.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.101.v: जरस् may be substituted for जरा , optionally before a case-affix beginning with a vowel.
7.2.101.e: The word जरा is optionally converted to the word जरस् when followed by an अजादि विभक्ति.
7.2.101.sa: जरा-शब्दस्य अजादिषु विभक्तिषु परेषु विकल्पेन 'जरस्' आदेशः भवति ।
7.2.101.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.102.v: For the final of त्यद् etc. there is substituted अ when an affix called विभक्ति follows.
7.2.102.e: The words of त्यदादिगण get an अकारादेश when followed by a विभक्तिप्रत्यय.
7.2.102.sa: त्यदादिगणस्य शब्दानाम् विभक्तिप्रत्यये परे अकारादेशः भवति ।
7.2.102.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.103.v: क is substituted for किम् before a विभक्ति affix.
7.2.103.e: The word किम् is converted to 'क' in presence of a विभक्ति प्रत्यय.
7.2.103.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.104.v: कु is substituted for किम् before a विभक्ति affix beginning with a त or ह।
7.2.104.e: The word किम् is converted to कु when followed by a विभक्तिप्रत्यय that begins with a शब्दस्य तकार or a हकार.
7.2.104.sa: किम्-शब्दस्य तकारादौ हकारादौ च विभक्तिप्रत्यये परे 'कु' आदेशः भवति ।
7.2.104.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.105.v: कु is substituted for किम् before the विभक्ति अत् ।
7.2.105.e: The word किम् is converted to क्व when followed by the  विभक्तिप्रत्यय 'अत्'.
7.2.105.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.106.v: For the non-final त् and द् of त्यद् etc. there is substituted स् in the Nominative 1st-Case singular.
7.2.106.e: For the words of त्यदादिगण, a तकार or a  दकार which is not at end of the word is converted to सकार when followed by the सुँ-प्रत्यय.
7.2.106.sa: त्यदादिगणस्य शब्देषु विद्यमानः यः तकारः दकारः च अन्ते नास्ति, तस्य सुँ-प्रत्यये परे सकारादेशः भवति ।
7.2.106.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.107.v: For the स् of अदस् there is substituted औ whereby the Nominative 1st-Case singular affix सु is elided.
7.2.107.e: The word अदस् gets an 'औ' आदेशः when followed by the सुँ-प्रत्यय, and the सुँ-प्रत्यय is removed.
7.2.107.sa: अदस्-शब्दस्य सुँ-प्रत्यये परे 'औ' आदेशः भवति, अदस्-शब्दात् परस्य 'सुँ' प्रत्ययस्य च लोपः भवति ।
7.2.107.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.108.v: म् is substituted for the final म् of इदम् in the Nominative 1st-Case singular.
7.2.108.e: The word इदम् gets a मकारादेश when followed by the सुँ-प्रत्यय.
7.2.108.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.109.v: म् is substituted for the द् of इदम् before a विभक्ति affix.
7.2.109.e: The दकार of the word इदम् is converted to a मकार when followed by a विभक्तिप्रत्यय.
7.2.109.sa: इदम्-शब्दस्य दकारस्य विभक्तिप्रत्यये परे मकारादेशः भवति ।
7.2.109.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.110.v: म् is substituted for the द् of इदम् before a विभक्ति affix.
7.2.110.e: The दकार of the word  इदम् is converted to यकार when followed by the  सुँ-प्रत्यय.
7.2.110.sa: इदम्-शब्दस्य दकारस्य सुँ-प्रत्यये परे यकारादेशः भवति ।
7.2.110.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.111.v: अय् is substituted for the इद् of इदम् in the Nominative 1st-Case singular masculine.
7.2.111.e: In पुंलिङ्ग, the 'इद्' part of the word 'इदम्' is converted to  'अय्' when followed by the  सुँ-प्रत्यय.
7.2.111.sa: पुंलिङ्गे इदम्-शब्दस्य 'इद्' इत्यस्य सुँ-प्रत्यये परे 'अय्' आदेशः भवति ।
7.2.111.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.112.v: अन is substituted for the इद् of इदम् in the Instrumental -3rd case singular and the cases that follow, provided that the augment अकच् is not added.
7.2.112.e: The 'इद्' part of the word  'इदम्' is converted to अन् when followed by a विभक्तिप्रत्यय of तृतीया to सप्तमी.  But this conversion does not happen if the word इदम् has a ककार in it.
7.2.112.sa: अककारस्य इदम्-शब्दस्य 'इद्' इत्यस्य तृतीयातः सप्तमी-यावत्सु विभक्तिप्रत्ययेषु परेषु 'अन्' आदेशः भवति ।
7.2.112.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.113.v: The इद् of इदम् is elided before a विभक्ति affix beginning with a consonant.
7.2.113.e: The 'इद्' part of the word 'इदम्' is removed when followed by a हलादि विभक्तिप्रत्यय of तृतीया to सप्तमी. But this conversion does not happen if the word इदम् has a ककार in it.
7.2.113.sa: अककारान्त-इदम्-शब्दस्य 'इद्' इत्यस्य तृतीयातः सप्तमी-यावत्सु हलादिप्रत्ययेषु  परेषु लोपः भवति ।
7.2.113.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.114.v: The वृद्धि (आर्) is substituted for the root vowel (ऋ) of the अङ्ग (stem) मृज् before an affix.
7.2.114.e: The verb root मृज् undergoes a वृद्धि.
7.2.114.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.115.v: Before the affixes having an indicatory ञ् or ण् , वृद्धि is substituted for the end-vowel of a अङ्ग (stem).
7.2.115.e: An अजन्त अङ्ग undergoes वृद्धि when followed by a  णित् or a ञित् प्रत्यय.
7.2.115.sa: अजन्तस्य अङ्गस्य णित् ञित्  प्रत्यये परे च वृद्धिः भवति ।
7.2.115.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.116.v: In a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a consonant with an अ immediately preceding it, the वृद्धि is substituted for such अ when followed by an indicatory ञ् or ण्।
7.2.116.e: The उपधा-अकार of an अङ्ग undergoes a वृद्धिः when followed by a णित् or a ञित् प्रत्यय.
7.2.116.sa: अङ्गस्य उपधा-अकारस्य णित् ञित् प्रत्यये परे च वृद्धिः भवति ।
7.2.116.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.117.v: The वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) when a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् or ण् follows.
7.2.117.e: When followed by a णित् / ञित् तद्धित-प्रत्यय, the आदि-स्वर of the अङ्ग undergoes a वृद्धि.
7.2.117.sa: णित् / ञित्-तद्धित-प्रत्यये परे अङ्गस्य आदि-स्वरस्य वृद्धिः भवति ।
7.2.117.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.2.118.v: The वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) when a तद्धित affix with an indicatory क् follows.
7.2.118.e: When followed by a कित् तद्धित-प्रत्यय, the आदि-स्वर of the अङ्ग undergoes a वृद्धि.
7.2.118.sa: कित्-तद्धित-प्रत्यये परे अङ्गस्य आदि-स्वरस्य वृद्धिः भवति ।
7.2.118.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation
